book.name: 2 Tesalonika
book.title: 2 Tesalonika Paulus susura kadua na fee lahenda kamahereꞌ fo rai kota Tesalonika

content: Au, Paulus ma nonoo kara Silas no Timotius, ami malosaꞌ haraꞌ soda-moleꞌ neuꞌ emi. Ami telu haitua susuraꞌ ia fee emi lahenda kamahereꞌ nai kota Tesalonika. Emi riꞌ here ao mara tuka Manetualain ita Aman, ma Yesus Kristus ita Ramatua na.
Ami telu hule fo Ara ratudu dale malole nara reuꞌ emi, ela leoꞌ bea na emi bisa masoda no tetu-temaꞌ, mole-dame, ma tesatei-tamadaleꞌ.
Toranoo kara emin! Muste ami hule makasi laꞌo naroo neuꞌ Manetualain, huu no emi boe-boe mamahere Ni, ma emi tamba masue-malai ao esa no esa.

Huu ria de, ami tui emi leleo-lalaꞌo mara neuꞌ Manetualain lahenda kamahereꞌ nara rai basa mamanaꞌ ara. Ami tui mae, emi manenete maroo, nai namahere mara daleꞌ, leo mae lahenda fekeꞌ ara ese-rumu rasususaꞌ emi.
Basa ia ra natudu nae, neuꞌ ko Manetualain naetuꞌ emi dedea mara no matetuꞌ. Susa-lela fo besaꞌ ia emi lepa-masaa, tao na emi maraa dadi meuꞌ Ria anaraun ara. Ria riꞌ emi Maneꞌ ma.
Bosoꞌ bii, huu fo Manetualain tuka roo na. Mete leo! Neuꞌ ko, Ana balas lahenda fo tao doidoso emi a.

Ma, Ria boe fee emi hahae memeꞌ doidosoꞌ fo emi lepa-masaa a. Ria tao leo naꞌ fee ami boe. Neuꞌ ko basa ia ra dadi, tepoꞌ fo Ramatua Yesus onda mai, sama-sama no eilaꞌo-limalope manakuasa nara reme nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a mai.
Ara onda mai, roo ai-pilaꞌ bauinaꞌ. Boe ma Ana fee huhukuꞌ neuꞌ bea fo ta nau nalelaꞌ Manetualain, ma ta nau tuka Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole Na.
Ana fee huhuku mabera neuꞌ basa si, losaꞌ ralulutuꞌ losa doo-doo na neu. Ana usi heni si remeꞌ mata Na mai, de ara ta rameda rita Ria kuasa marela-masaꞌa Na soꞌ.

Tepoꞌ fo Ana mai, basa lahenda kamahereꞌ ara, soꞌu radedema nade Na ma fee hada-horomata neuꞌ Ana. Neuꞌ ko emi boe nai lahenda kamahereꞌ ara talada, nana huu emi sipoꞌ ma Tutui Malolen fo fai maneuꞌ ara ami tui-bekan neuꞌ emi so a.

Huu ria na, ami hule-haradoi fee emi laꞌo naroo, ela Manetualain tao emi meuꞌ lahenda fo raadaleꞌ-toꞌeteiꞌ. Ami boe hule fo Ana fee kuasa Na neuꞌ emi, ela bisa tao basa hihii-nanauꞌ malole, tuka hata fo emi maetuꞌ nau tao ni, ma hata fo emi mamahere.

Maneniko emi masoda tuka enoꞌ ria, neuꞌ ko lahenda ra soꞌu radedema Ramatua Yesus Nade Na. Ma emi boe hapu iꞌioꞌ, nana huu emi tuka Ni. Basa ia ra reme ita Aman Manetualain ma Ramatua Yesus Kristus dale malole Na mai.
